What reads 'Not checked' is everything the head does not carry and the checker does not report: GA4 measurement inside the GTM container (a container is not a measurement - nothing is counted until a tag is published inside it), Open Graph tags, JSON-LD schema, the favicon, the sitemap and the image alt-text counts.

issues: Your 14 live Google ads are booked under a different legal entity: the verified advertiser record reads ECOILA PRIVATE LIMITED, not Green Carbon Hub. Anyone who checks the transparency centre sees a company name that does not match the brand on the ad.

Your <title> is 'GreenCarbonHub' - 14 characters with no service, no city and no offer - and your meta description element is shipped with an empty content attribute. Both Google ads are buying 'solar rooftop service providers in Hyderabad' and 'subsidy up to Rs 78,000' into a page that says neither.

The only tracking on the site is GTM container GTM-TX4XRLT and Meta Pixel 1088807282778475. A container is not a measurement - no GA4 measurement ID could be read inside it - so 14 Google ads and 2 Meta ads run with no confirmed analytics behind them.

The second phone number on your site dials the first one: the offcanvas contact block renders '+91 9182445715' inside an <a href="tel:9182445300">. A buyer who taps the second number reaches the wrong line.

There is no <h1> anywhere in the served page. The checker reports an <h4> following an <h2> with nothing between them, a <button> inside an <a> at source line 681, an unclosed <main>, a duplicate <body> and two <header> elements (one a sticky clone), on 34 errors total.

Your navigation is mostly commented out - the live page serves a commented-out menu and a block of commented-out call / WhatsApp CSS - and the 'Login' button in the header points at contact.html. The only working conversion routes are the form, the phone links and the chat widget.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md).
